01 / The House

Made for those who move quietly.

LUCENNOIR is built around restraint: heavyweight silhouettes, washed colour, silver-toned graphics and details that reward a closer look.

Explore the pieces →
+
Stories / 001

After dark.

Notes from the first collection — why the graphics, fabrics and colours look the way they do.

01 / IDEA

Built from contrast.

Small front marks keep the pieces quiet from a distance. Larger back graphics give each design its identity when you walk away.

02 / FABRIC

Washed, weighted, worn.

Black is the foundation, but the collection moves through charcoal, navy, brown, olive and stone so the house never feels one-dimensional.

03 / FUTURE

001 is only the beginning.

The first collection establishes the visual language. Future drops can push it further without losing the same quiet attitude.
